description: Canonical type signatures for json-fn builtins. Shared across implementations to reduce drift. See docs/builtin-signatures.md for the dialect.

sub.description: Subtract the second number from the first.

mod.description: Return the remainder after division; throws when the divisor is zero.

div.description: Divide two numbers; throws when the divisor is zero.

abs.description: Return the absolute value of a number.

floor.description: Round a number down to the nearest integer.

ceil.description: Round a number up to the nearest integer.

round.description: Round a number to the nearest integer.

trunc.description: Discard the fractional part of a number, rounding toward zero.

sign.description: Return -1, 0, or 1 according to the sign of a number.

clamp.description: Constrain a number to an inclusive minimum and maximum; throws when the minimum exceeds the maximum.

max.description: Return the largest number in a non-empty array; throws if the result is not finite.

min.description: Return the smallest number in a non-empty array; throws if the result is not finite.

sum.description: Sum an array of numbers, returning zero for an empty array; throws if the result is not finite.

mean.description: Return the arithmetic mean of a non-empty array of numbers.

product.description: Multiply an array of numbers, returning one for an empty array; throws if the result is not finite.

argmin.description: Return the index of the first smallest number, or null for an empty array.

argmax.description: Return the index of the first largest number, or null for an empty array.

sqrt.description: Return the square root of a number; throws if the result is not finite.

pow.description: Raise a base to an exponent; throws if the result is not finite.

exp.description: Raise Euler's number to a power; throws if the result is not finite.

log.description: Return the natural logarithm of a number; throws if the result is not finite.

log10.description: Return the base-10 logarithm of a number; throws if the result is not finite.

sin.description: Return the sine of an angle in radians; throws if the result is not finite.

cos.description: Return the cosine of an angle in radians; throws if the result is not finite.

tan.description: Return the tangent of an angle in radians; throws if the result is not finite.

atan2.description: Return the angle in radians from the positive x-axis to the point (x, y); throws if the result is not finite.

eq.description: Test two values for structural equality.

neq.description: Test two values for structural inequality.

lt.description: Test whether the first number is less than the second.

lte.description: Test whether the first number is less than or equal to the second.

gt.description: Test whether the first number is greater than the second.

gte.description: Test whether the first number is greater than or equal to the second.

not.description: Return the logical negation of a boolean.

and.description: Return the eager logical conjunction of two booleans.

or.description: Return the eager logical disjunction of two booleans.

isNull.description: Test whether a value is null.

isBool.description: Test whether a value is a boolean.

isNumber.description: Test whether a value is a number.

isInteger.description: Test whether a value is an integer.

isString.description: Test whether a value is a string.

isArray.description: Test whether a value is an array.

isObject.description: Test whether a value is a plain object, excluding arrays and null.

isTask.description: Test whether a value is a plain object with a string-valued `@task` tag.

str.description: Convert a value to a string, serializing non-string values.

num.description: Convert a value to a number; throws when conversion fails.

trim.description: Remove whitespace from both ends of a string.

split.description: Split a string on a separator.

join.description: Join an array's elements with a separator.

startsWith.description: Test whether a string starts with a prefix.

endsWith.description: Test whether a string ends with a suffix.

replace.description: Replace all literal, non-overlapping occurrences of a non-empty search string.

padStart.description: Left-pad a string to a Unicode code-point length, using a space when no fill string is supplied.

padEnd.description: Right-pad a string to a Unicode code-point length, using a space when no fill string is supplied.

length.description: Return the length of an array or string.

head.description: Return the first element of an array, or null when empty.

last.description: Return the last element of an array, or null when empty.

tail.description: Return all but the first element of an array.

reverse.description: Return a reversed copy of an array.

take.description: Return the first requested number of array elements, or an empty array when the count is non-positive.

drop.description: Return an array without its first requested number of elements, or a copy when the count is non-positive.

zip.description: Pair corresponding elements, stopping at the shorter array.

unique.description: Keep the first occurrence of each structurally distinct array value.

repeat.description: Repeat an array or string a non-negative number of times.

flatten.description: Flatten an array by one level.

flattenDepth.description: Flatten an array by a non-negative number of levels.

chunk.description: Split an array into consecutive chunks of a positive size.

frequencies.description: Count occurrences of scalar values after converting each value to an object key.

range.description: Create an array of integers from zero up to, but excluding, an endpoint.

rangeFrom.description: Create a half-open ascending range of integers between two endpoints.

rangeBy.description: Create a half-open range of integers using a non-zero step.

slice.description: Return a slice of an array or string.

includes.description: Test an array for a structurally equal value, or a string for a substring.

indexOf.description: Find a structurally equal array value or string substring, returning null when absent.

setAt.description: Return an array with one element replaced.

fromEntries.description: Create an object from key-value pairs.

merge.description: Shallowly merge two objects, with the second object's values winning conflicts.

hasKey.description: Test whether an object contains a key.

pick.description: Return an object containing selected keys.

omit.description: Return an object excluding selected keys.

map.description: Transform each array element with a callback.

mapIndexed.description: Transform each array element with a callback that also receives its index.

filter.description: Keep array elements for which a callback returns true.

filterIndexed.description: Keep array elements using a callback that also receives each index.

reduce.description: Fold an array into an accumulator.

reduceIndexed.description: Fold an array with a callback that also receives each index.

partition.description: Split an array into matching and non-matching elements after one predicate call per element.

scan.description: Return each post-callback accumulator produced while folding an array.

find.description: Return the first array element matching a callback, or null.

findIndexed.description: Find an array element with a callback that also receives each index.

findIndex.description: Return the index of the first callback match, or null.

findIndexIndexed.description: Find a matching index with a callback that also receives each index.

some.description: Test whether any array element matches a callback.

someIndexed.description: Test for a match with a callback that also receives each index.

every.description: Test whether every array element matches a callback.

everyIndexed.description: Test every element with a callback that also receives each index.

count.description: Count array elements matching a callback.

countIndexed.description: Count matches with a callback that also receives each index.

countBy.description: Count array elements by callback-produced string or numeric keys.

sort.description: Return a sorted copy of an array, optionally using a comparator; the default orders homogeneous numbers ascending or homogeneous strings by Unicode code point.

sortBy.description: Return an array sorted by callback-produced keys.

sortByIndexed.description: Sort by keys from a callback that also receives each index.

groupBy.description: Group array elements by callback-produced keys.

groupByIndexed.description: Group by keys from a callback that also receives each index.

flatMap.description: Transform array elements, flattening array results by one level and retaining scalar results.

flatMapIndexed.description: Flat-map while retaining scalar results, with a callback that also receives each index.

mapValues.description: Transform an object's values with a callback.

apply.description: Call a function with an array of positional arguments.

pipe.description: Pass a value through an array of functions from left to right.

reTest.description: Test whether a regex pattern matches anywhere in a string.

reMatch.description: Return the first regex match object, or null.

reMatchAll.description: Return all non-overlapping regex match objects.

reReplace.description: Replace all regex matches using a replacement string, where `$&` is the full match and `$1`, `$2`, and so on are capture groups.

reSplit.description: Split a string using a regex pattern.

reReplaceWith.description: Replace all regex matches using a callback that receives a match object.

perform.description: Build a task requesting a named effect with arguments.

pure.description: Build a completed task carrying a value.

bind.description: Sequence a task into a continuation that returns the next task.

raise.description: Build a task requesting the raise effect, equivalent to `perform("raise", [value])`.

handle.description: Interpret a task's effects with handler clauses; an optional raw result schema makes the handler total and runtime-validated.

arity.description: Return a function name or body's fixed positional parameter count, excluding its rest parameter, or null when unknown.

tap.description: Pass a value and optional label to the host-configured logger and return the value unchanged.
